recognize_zh: 腰椎矢狀面 T1 脂肪抑制打顯影劑影像：椎體骨髓訊號不均勻，夾雜多個斑片狀強化區與低訊號病灶，上方胸腰交界的後方結構與椎管後側有明顯強化，符合骨髓瘤活動性病灶並可能延伸至硬膜外。
features: Sagittal fat-suppressed post-contrast T1-weighted MRI of the lower thoracic and lumbar spine
Diffusely heterogeneous marrow signal with patchy enhancing foci in multiple vertebral bodies
Several rounded non-enhancing hypointense foci within vertebral bodies
Avid enhancement of posterior elements at the upper (thoracolumbar) level extending toward the posterior spinal canal
Intervertebral discs not enhancing; sacrum also shows heterogeneous signal
describe_en: Sagittal fat-suppressed post-contrast T1-weighted MRI of the lumbar spine shows diffusely heterogeneous marrow signal with patchy enhancing foci and scattered rounded hypointense lesions in multiple vertebral bodies and the sacrum. At the upper (thoracolumbar) level there is avid enhancement of the posterior elements extending toward the dorsal spinal canal, raising concern for epidural extension. The intervertebral discs are not involved. The pattern of multifocal enhancing marrow lesions superimposed on diffuse marrow abnormality is consistent with active myelomatous involvement.

ddx.vs: Metastases give a similar multifocal enhancing pattern, so M-protein studies and bone marrow or lesion biopsy are needed to distinguish them.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma of bone with epidural extension
ddx.vs: Lymphoma can also cause marrow infiltration with epidural soft tissue, and tissue diagnosis (CD20/PAX5 versus CD138/light chains) is required.
Infection shows disc and endplate involvement with rim-enhancing fluid collections, whereas discs are spared here.
